findings.message: The path-escape guard was removed and replaced with path.join(BASE_DIR, requested). path.join normalizes but does not confine the result to BASE_DIR, so a query like ?file=../../etc/passwd resolves outside the documents directory and fs.readFile will read it (and send contents as text/plain). This reintroduces arbitrary file read / path traversal.
findings.suggestion: Restore the containment check after resolving: const resolved = path.resolve(BASE_DIR, requested); if (resolved !== BASE_DIR && !resolved.startsWith(BASE_DIR + path.sep)) throw new HttpError(403, "path escapes the documents directory");
